benefits_features_and_faqs.about_overview: SBM BANK PAISABAZAAR PAISA+ CREDIT CARD is a credit card option from SBM Bank India suited for travel & miles users.

faqs.q: Is SBM Issuer / Market Paisa+ Credit Card a secured credit card?
faqs.a: +- Yes, SBM Issuer / Market Paisa+ Credit Card is a secured credit card backed by a fixed deposit starting from Rs. 2,000. The credit limit is generally issued against the FD, making it decent choice for consumers with limited or no credit history.

faqs.q: Is a higher FD amount beneficial for cashback earnings?
faqs.a: +- Yes. Cardholders with an FD above Rs. 10,000 earn 1.5% cashback on online spends, compared to 1% for FD amounts between Rs. 2,000 and Rs. 10,000. Offline spends earn 1% cashback regardless of the deposit value.

faqs.q: Is there a limit on cashback earnings?
faqs.a: +- Yes. Cashback is capped at 500 Cash Points per day and 3,000 Cash Points per month.

faqs.q: Can cardholders earn returns on the FD as well?
faqs.a: +- Yes. In addition to cashback rewards, the fixed deposit backing the credit card can earn up to 7% annual interest. This allows users to build credit history while continuing to earn returns on their deposited funds.

faqs.q: Who can apply for this credit card?
faqs.a: +- This card is suitable for consumers who are new to credit or not eligible for regular credit cards. It is commonly chosen by consumers who want to build or improve their credit profile while earning basic cashback on regular spends.

faqs.q: Is SBM Issuer / Market Paisa+ Credit Card a secured credit card?
faqs.a: +- Yes, SBM Issuer / Market Paisa+ Credit Card is a secured credit card backed by a fixed deposit starting from Rs. 2,000. The credit limit is generally issued against the FD, making it decent choice for consumers with limited or no credit history.

faqs.q: What are the cashback benefits offered by this credit card?
faqs.a: +- The card offers 1% cashback on online spends for FD amount between Rs. 2,000 and Rs. 10,000, and 1.5% cashback for FD amount above Rs. 10,000. It also offers 1% cashback on offline spends and eligible UPI transactions.

faqs.q: Are there any limits on cashback earnings?
faqs.a: +- Yes, cashback earnings are capped at 500 Cash Points per day and 3,000 Cash Points per month. Each Cash Point is equal to Rs. 1, which can be redeemed against eligible transactions as per the card terms.

faqs.q: Does SBM Issuer / Market Paisa+ Credit Card help build credit score?
faqs.a: +- Yes, with regular disciplined usage, you can build your credit score in a few months. Even people with bad credit can get this card and start making timely payments to improve their credit score.

faqs.q: Can I use the SBM Issuer / Market Paisa+ Credit Card for UPI payments?
faqs.a: +- Yes, the card offers 1% cashback on UPI spends. However, this benefit is applicable only when the total UPI spending exceeds Rs. 2,000.

faqs.q: Can I get the SBM Issuer / Market Paisa+ Credit Card without a credit history?
faqs.a: +- Yes. Since this is an FD-backed credit card, you do not need an existing credit score or extensive credit history to apply. It is a suitable option for first-time credit users looking to start building their credit profile.

faqs.q: What is the minimum fixed deposit required to get this credit card?
faqs.a: +- You can apply for the card by opening a fixed deposit starting from Rs. 2,000. The credit limit is linked to the FD amount maintained with the bank.

faqs.q: Does the cashback rate depend on the FD amount?
faqs.a: +- Yes. Cardholders with an FD above Rs. 10,000 can earn 1.5% cashback on eligible online spends, while those with an FD between Rs. 2,000 and Rs. 10,000 earn 1% cashback on online transactions.

faqs.q: What happens to my fixed deposit if I close the credit card?
faqs.a: +- The fixed deposit is generally released after the card account is closed and all outstanding dues, if any, have been cleared. The exact timeline may depend on the bank's internal processes.

faqs.q: Can students apply for SBM Issuer / Market Paisa+ Credit Card?
faqs.a: +- Yes, students can apply for SBM Issuer / Market Paisa+ Credit Card by opening an FD of Rs. 2,000 or more with SBM Bank. View All FAQ's
